intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The diagonal cut has no structural merit.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You and Kaedra are disagreeing about sandwiches. She cuts straight across. You cut corner to corner.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “It gives you a point to start from. It’s better design.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “We disagree about something inconsequential. Shall I alert the heralds?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Only if they’ve got nothing better to announce.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I have never seen a royal bulletin titled *Two People Remain Fond of Each Other*.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She cuts the next sandwich straight across and hands you half. Then she cuts your half corner to corner.

options.labelText: “You know what, you’re right. Straight across, then.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “No. You were wrong with conviction. I was enjoying it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She cuts the next sandwich corner to corner and waits for you to object.
